applicability.scope: Diagnose PyTorch accelerator memory, CUDA caching allocation, asynchronous stream dependencies and CUDA graph replay lifetimes.
prerequisites: An explicitly selected installed torch environment; actual devices for backend-specific checks.
applicability.input_contract: A bounded model, tensor, data or environment reproduction and expected behavior.
applicability.produced_artifact: Produce a storage and stream lifetime ledger plus a bounded allocator or graph reproduction.
failure_modes: Transferring source facts to another wheel or backend without checking drift.
applicability.refusal_point: Withhold backend success when the required device check cannot execute.

limitations: Source-supported procedures are not full-repository execution coverage.
Required unavailable backends retain BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND; no measured efficacy claim.
